summary: [FE API 16.01] [ADDED] Own Patient Medical Record Overview — GET /api/v1/patients/me/medical-record/overview
description:
h1. Phase 16 — Own Patient Medical Record Overview

*Existing backend contract:* P16-01
*HTTP:* {{GET /api/v1/patients/me/medical-record/overview}}
*Actor:* Patient self
*Permission:* {{MedicalRecords.ViewOwn}}
*Backend status:* *IMPLEMENTED*; implementation does NOT constitute production privacy/clinical sign-off.
*Expected response:* Overview (exact field-level DTO in linked source document).

h2. UI screen and connected flow

Patient Medical Record Home: open summary counts, patient-safe mode and availableFilters; navigate via returned timeline links.

*Journey context:* Feature Story [WAS-578|https://loaisabir.atlassian.net/browse/WAS-578] (Medical Record/Visibility) and [WAS-566|https://loaisabir.atlassian.net/browse/WAS-566] (Family).

h2. Contract and safety details

* Read source patient from own linked account, or treating Ticket; never trust client-supplied arbitrary PatientId. Doctor requires current approved active Doctor + owned Practice + exact Ticket AND matching Encounter InProgress + current permission + sharing gate.
* List/Timeline: types=all|visits|diagnoses|prescriptions|labs|radiology; fromDate, toDate, cursor, pageSize (1..100, default20) where applicable. Hidden encounters return placeholders rather than source IDs/clinical data. Cursors are authenticated and actor/scope/filter-bound; restart first page on invalidation.
* Response JSON camelCase and string enums. Errors: 401 unauthenticated, safe 404 (gated/not owned/missing), 409 conflict, 422 invalid cursor/filter, 429 rate limit, audit failures fail closed. Do NOT infer access from having a permission alone.

h2. Frontend acceptance

* Typed response model, loading/empty/paginated states; no fabricated patient summary/counters.
* Scope/relationship guards + privacy-sensitive 401/403/404/429 UX.
* Navigate only by IDs provided by eligible list/detail, preserve filters; do not parse opaque cursor.
* No clinical details/source IDs leak through Hidden placeholder, URL or logs.
* Render disabled/gated feature as unavailable, not as a successful empty clinical record.
* Arabic/English labels and accessible responsive UI.

*Exact API authority:* https://github.com/LoaiSaberC4r/Wasla/blob/main/PHASE-16-API-CHANGES.md
*Approved parent/Guardian gap:* https://github.com/LoaiSaberC4r/Wasla/blob/main/PHASE-16-FINAL-GAP-API-DIFF.md

h2. Contract and safety details

* Read source patient from own linked account, or treating Ticket; never trust client-supplied arbitrary PatientId. Doctor requires current approved active Doctor + owned Practice + exact Ticket AND matching Encounter InProgress + current permission + sharing gate.
* List/Timeline: types=all|visits|diagnoses|prescriptions|labs|radiology; fromDate, toDate, cursor, pageSize (1..100, default20) where applicable. Hidden encounters return placeholders rather than source IDs/clinical data. Cursors are authenticated and actor/scope/filter-bound; restart first page on invalidation.
* Response JSON camelCase and string enums. Errors: 401 unauthenticated, safe 404 (gated/not owned/missing), 409 conflict, 422 invalid cursor/filter, 429 rate limit, audit failures fail closed. Do NOT infer access from having a permission alone.

* Typed response model, loading/empty/paginated states; no fabricated patient summary/counters.
* Scope/relationship guards + privacy-sensitive 401/403/404/429 UX.
* Navigate only by IDs provided by eligible list/detail, preserve filters; do not parse opaque cursor.
* No clinical details/source IDs leak through Hidden placeholder, URL or logs.
* Render disabled/gated feature as unavailable, not as a successful empty clinical record.
* Arabic/English labels and accessible responsive UI.
